ns2:section.sectionText: This course has reserved seating. Freshman and sophomores in LAS, FAA, BUS get priority. Any exceptions to this must be approved in writing by Professor Hammack (Hammack@netbox.com). Any exceptions that are not approved by him, errors in admittance, or overrides that violate the selection criteria for this section will be corrected before the semester starts. Others may send name, UIN, college, class, to hammack@netbox.com to be put on a waiting list.
